derivation: from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong;
def: the body (as being rolled together); also powerful

occurrences.text: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
